integrity: The all-parameter proof is analytic. Symbolic and finite-graph independent checks corroborate, but are not substitutes for the proof. Kernel-sign attainment is in L-infinity and is not asserted for continuous input functions.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge, constant-density complete metric graphs with continuous edgewise quadratic polynomials; the full norm is proved for \(n\ge6\) only, the vertex norm for \(n\ge3\). No conclusion for other graphs, higher degrees, or weighted edges. Earlier unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Sharp quadratic least-squares stability on complete metric graphs
